I'll calculate the number of days between 2015-12-17 and 2019-02-24 for you.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime

start_date = datetime(2015, 12, 17)
end_date = datetime(2019, 2, 24)

difference = end_date - start_date
days = difference.days

print(f"Start date: {start_date.date()}")
print(f"End date: {end_date.date()}")
print(f"Number of days: {days}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke name
>
</function_calls>

**The difference is 1,165 days** between 2015-12-17 and 2019-02-24.

This counts the number of complete days from the start date to the end date (not including the start date itself, but including up to the end date).
